# libaribb25 ABI header

Source: https://github.com/tsukumijima/libaribb25/tree/c30cbd1357f08129da59c2fcd01a0b1be50220c5

Version: v0.2.10. Only the official IB25Decoder.h, LICENSE and NOTICE are included.
Line endings are normalized to LF; interface declarations are unchanged.
No upstream implementation or DLL is included. Include Windows.h before this header.
See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at the distribution root for attribution and README.md for runtime requirements.
